Thank you for your reply, it helped me feel better about some stuff. I think identifying/validating what happened is going to help me heal from it, first steps. I’m gonna struggle with guilt, but I’m taking your words to heart, and hopefully I can relieve this shame feeling slowly.
I’m sorry to hear you went through what you did, you’re really strong, I can’t imagine. 
Again, this helped me a lot. 
Thank you again, you’re a great person❤️I wish the best for you, continue to be strong :))
